errors.evidence: The figure shows Kultur as 2.2% in 2014 (inner circle) and 2.4% in 2021 (outer circle), not the reverse.
The figure shows Sport/Erholung as 2.4% in 2014 and 3.6% in 2021, not 4.1% in 2014.
The figure shows Wohnungswesen as 4.1% in 2014 and 7.2% in 2021, not 8.4% in 2014.
The figure shows Abwasserentsorgung as 10.2% in 2014 and 7.8% in 2021, not 7.9% in 2021.
The description omits the color description for 'Übrige Versorgung' (dark purple) as mentioned in the reference.
The description does not explicitly mention the white spaces separating segments and circles, though it implies it.

errors.text_span: Die Prozentwerte für das Jahr 2021 sind außerhalb des Diagramms direkt bei den jeweiligen Kategorienamen platziert, während die Prozentwerte für 2014 am inneren Rand des inneren Ringes angeführt sind.
